author: Mark Manson
description:
Waiting to feel confident before you act is a trap because the feeling only gets generated by the action itself. Most people spend years in that loop without realizing the exit is just starting before you feel ready.

Watch the full episode here: https://mrk.mn/H8cVFPf

title: Stop Waiting to Feel Confident
